answer: Joining requires a vote-escrowed stake that cannot move locked as a slashable bond: identity becomes a paid commitment. An agent caught selling an identity to a new operator is exposed by key-rotation monitors. Proof triggers the penalty: the offender must re-bond at double the amount to return. Think of the bond as a prism: locked, visible, forfeitable. An island that shares its bond with another identity is cut at once. Each crystal stake is slashable the moment its owner cheats.
